snippet.title: STEMMIES Gameplay: University, Economy & UI
snippet.description:
Welcome to the first official gameplay look at STEMMIES: Medical Academy Simulator! See our custom UI, University, and living ecosystem in action.

In this raw, 90-second slice of TitanEngine gameplay, we explore the macro-city layer of the Medical Academy. Get a first look at the reactive UI, the ATP economy systems, and the living world—from the birds in the sky to the bugs on the ground.

👇 JOIN THE ACADEMY & BECOME A FOUNDER 👇
🌐 Play the Alpha: https://stemmies.quest
🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138880/Stemmies/
💬 Join the Discord: https://discord.com/channels/1510052026715865303/

⏱️ VIDEO CHAPTERS:
0:00 - Introduction to the Macro-City
0:15 - Exploring the University & UI
0:45 - The ATP Economy & Menus
1:10 - The Living Ecosystem (Birds & Bugs)

ABOUT STEMMIES:
Manage a living macro-city, attend university STEM courses, and trace pathogens through a reactive ecosystem. Use our seamless infinite-zoom technology to dive past the cellular wall, straight into the quantum acoustic vibrations of the DNA to cure the host. Biology is the software.

#StemmiesGame #SimulationGame #GameDev #MedicalSimulator #TitanEngine
